access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5.5 Instant release of May 5, 2026, exposed on the first-party API only as the moving chat-latest alias with no documented fixed snapshot: the alias page lists chat-latest as both model ID and sole snapshot and states the underlying snapshot is regularly updated. Azure Foundry hosts the same line as dated gpt-chat-latest preview deployments naming GPT-5.5 Instant as the OpenAI-side equivalent. The base GPT-5.5 release, GPT-5.5 Pro, the invite-only Cyber preview, ChatGPT application behaviors, Codex, the GPT-5.3 Instant predecessor, fine-tuned derivatives, and later Instant generations are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: The launch announcement pins the release date and the API identity, and Azure documents dated gpt-chat-latest preview deployments mapped to GPT-5.5 Instant
First-party alias page plus system card establish Chat Completions and Responses support with image input
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights and no pinnable first-party snapshot exist, so production behavior can drift as the alias rotates
The only third-party hosting path is an Azure preview-lifecycle product, and the live alias page recommends GPT-6 Astra for production API use
